# Introduction to Linear Algebra — Vectors and Matrices

Book Chapter 2 introduces definitions, vector operations, matrix operations and linearity. Think of vectors as arrows and matrices as rules for moving arrows.

## Follow the chapters

1. [vectors and operations](01-vectors-and-operations.qmd)
2. [dot product and length](02-dot-product-and-length.qmd)
3. [matrices and linearity](03-matrices-and-linearity.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Introduction to Linear Algebra — Vectors and Matrices. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
